column3: “No early fig” supplies a second negative where the Hebrew says “my soul craves an early fig”.
“Euphrates” identifies the river not named in the Hebrew.
“My” is supplied; the recipient “him” is omitted.
“Deprived of” is supplied before their might.
“Crawl” replaces the trembling in their coming out; “in the presence of” replaces their dread of the LORD.
